outcome: Cord blood anti-SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody titers (NT50)
Placental transfer ratio of neutralizing antibodies
cohort: The cohort consisted of pregnant women with and without Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) from the PIANO and PREVENT-COVID studies, and their neonates.
finding: Pregnant women with IBD on biologic therapies mount effective SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody responses and achieve efficient placental transfer of antibodies, similar to non-biologic-exposed pregnant women.
cross-section timing: Post-SARS-CoV-2 vaccination and at birth (for cord blood collection)
